description: This file implements platform-specific stack unwinding and symbolization functions for the PyTorch profiler, including handling of library information, unwinding logic, and symbolization via addr2line or fast symbolizer. It contains conditional compilation for Linux x86_64 platforms and defines functions for unwinding call stacks and resolving symbols.

classes.name: UpgradeExclusive
classes.description: Manages lock upgrading from shared to exclusive lock on a mutex.

classes.name: LibraryInfo
classes.description: Holds information about a loaded library, including name, load bias, last address, and unwinder creation.

classes.name: UnwindCache
classes.description: Caches library information and unwinder objects for stack unwinding.

classes.name: Symbolizer
classes.description: Handles symbolization of addresses to function names and source locations.

methods.name: unwind
methods.description: Performs stack unwinding and returns a vector of instruction pointers.

methods.name: libraryFor
methods.description: Returns the library name and offset for a given address.

methods.name: unwind_c
methods.description: C function that performs stack unwinding given stack pointers, called from assembly.
